task: put the cream cheese in the bowl

windows.text: Reach the open gripper horizontally across the table toward the black object on the white square.
Approach the black object on the white square from above, lowering the open gripper.
Approach the blue cream cheese block from above, lowering the open gripper toward it.
Approach the blue cream cheese block from above, lowering the open gripper to position its fingers around it.
Grasp the blue cream cheese block on the table and lift it upward.
Lift the blue cream cheese block up off the table, moving it toward the bowl.
Carry the blue cream cheese over the bowl.
Release the blue cream cheese block into the bowl and open the gripper.
Release the cream cheese into the bowl and retract the empty gripper upward.
Retract the open gripper upward from above the bowl.
